title: Search a 2D Matrix
statement: You are given an `m x n` `matrix` where each row is sorted ascending and the first entry of each row is greater than the last entry of the previous row. Return `true` if `target` appears in the matrix, else `false`. Treat the matrix as one sorted sequence and binary-search it; keep the 2D layout in a local named `matrix` so the tracer can draw the grid.

def search_matrix(matrix, target):

    rows, cols = len(matrix), len(matrix[0]) if matrix else 0
    left, right = 0, rows * cols - 1
